summary.name: LumaView
summary.one_liner: LumaView is a minimal native image viewer for Mac that opens each image in its own window for side-by-side comparison.
use_cases: compare details between two or more photos side by side
browse images in a folder with arrow keys
view HEIC, RAW, or WebP photos on a Mac
flip through pages of a multipage PDF
inspect EXIF metadata of an image
quickly zoom, pan, and rotate an image
summary.what_it_does: LumaView is a minimal native image viewer for macOS. Each image opens in its own window with its own zoom level and browsing position, so windows can be arranged side by side for comparison. You can browse other images in the same folder using the toolbar or arrow keys. It offers fit, zoom, pan, and rotate, with a status bar showing the current zoom level. It supports JPEG, PNG, HEIC, GIF, TIFF, WebP, RAW, Sketch previews, and multi-page PDFs. The Mac listing also describes EXIF metadata inspection.
notable: Each image opens in its own window for side-by-side comparison
